newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso ends at 1,107.20 -- new low vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso ends at 1,107.20 -- new low vs dlr.

text.p: Colombia's peso fell sharply Friday as corporate demand for dollars, and limited sales of U.S. currency by the export sector, pushed it to a new historic low of 1,107.20, interbank dealers said.
The peso ended 3.20 pesos lower against the dollar from Thursday's close and dealers said this was partly due to the fact that few petrodollars or coffee export revenues were entering the market.
There was also solid demand for greenbacks from the corporate sector, they said. Several said they saw the peso rebounding slightly next week, to a range of about 1,105.
Dealers reported 360 trades for a total of $178 million and said the peso closed just off its intraday low of 1,107.40.
